Towns with no townsfolk drawn keep their smoke as it is. hunger: in a starving town (the bridge's famine, the mirror's town mood) only this share of hearths smoke even with someone home (share), each at this share of its smoke (thin). look: how a chimney's smoke looks (batch 8b look2: bright white blobs): wood smoke's grey-brown (colour), how see-through it starts and ends (alpha), the puffs' size as they leave the chimney and how much they spread as they rise, how fast they rise and in how narrow a cone, how long each lives, how many, all drawn unlit; drift: how hard the one wind leans it (weather_fx.gd's wind). 01-town (the one view, round 1): soft pale grey-white wisps that read over the roofs, a little fuller and longer than batch 8b's, still never white blobs. chimneys: the share of houses built with a smoking chimney (towns.gd _put). cooking: the share of a town's hearths whose cooking fire burns whoever's in, at_meals inside its meals [from, to] hours on the village clock, between at other hours (01-town: thin wisps from a few chimneys; g28 landuse: every house smoked). far: the smoke thins as the lens draws back: full within near world units, down to amount of the puffs and alpha of the look at far (the town view stands about 2.4 off, the drawn-back land-use view about 9.6).
